card.name: The word right in picture captions
card.fires_on: The word "right" (or nearby words like "the" before "side") when it points to an image's position, as in "pictured right" or "see photo at right". It appears in web text that refers to a figure or photo beside the text.

modes.label: Pointer to picture on the right
modes.description: "right" after pictured, photo at, illus. at or picture at, telling the reader where the image is.

modes.label: Other image-position wording
modes.description: Words near "right" that also place an image or animation beside the text, such as a comma after "at right" or "the" before "side".
